eyebrow: A HELPFUL RECORD, NOT ANOTHER TASK
description: Keep a lightweight history of deposits, payments, income, and updates.
sample: Sample activity is illustrative—not your personal financial history.
emptyWithRecords: Whenever something changes, add a note here. It helps you remember why your numbers changed.
emptyWithoutRecords: Add an asset or debt first. You can then record a deposit, payment, or other update.
adjustValues: Some activity types also adjust a saved value when one is already known.
guidance: An entry is a record of what happened, not a bank transaction. Nothing is connected, transferred, or invested.
